# Bookmarks PRD

## 4. User stories
- **US-1** (Must): As a user, I want to save a link with a title and tags so that I can find it again.
- **US-2** (Should): As a user, I want to list my bookmarks filtered by tag.
- **US-3** (Could): As a user, I want to delete a bookmark.

## 5. Functional requirements
- **FR-001**: Users can save a link with a title and tags. (US-1)
- **FR-002**: Users can list their own bookmarks filtered by tag. (US-2)
- **FR-003**: Users can delete a bookmark. (US-3)
